context: Big extended family gathering: meal table conversations cross-thread.
purpose: Many voices at a holiday meal; warm-overlapping family chat.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: みんな揃って、嬉しいわ!
lines.style: Brassy, warm Kansai accent. Loud opening on joy, not performance. Spreads the happiness across the room like she's personally made sure everyone arrived. Genuine delight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Yeah, this is a fine gathering.
lines.style: Measured, weathered Kansai cadence. Slow, satisfied nod in the voice. Warm patriarch observing what's right in the world. No rush. Weight of contentment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Soft, attentive Kansai warmth. Offer wrapped in care—not serving, but family tending to family. Gentle hand motion implied in the voice. Familial ease.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 料理、たくさんありますよ。
lines.en: There's plenty of food for everyone.
lines.style: Tender, quiet hosting. Soft vowels. Gentle reassurance—not pushing, just ensuring no one goes without. The voice of someone who feeds people she loves.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃんの料理、最高!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded eight-year-old enthusiasm. Quick attack on 'best,' genuine admiration—not flattery. Sunny and sincere. The voice of a child who's just happy to be here.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Animated, generous Kansai aunt energy. Loud invitation—not command, insistence wrapped in affection. Quick, warm, slightly teasing. She wants everyone full and happy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: みんなの笑顔、ええなぁ。
lines.style: Soft, observant Kansai. Quiet wonder in the noticing. Speaks like he's discovering something true mid-sentence. Warm, a little tender, the artist seeing what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Gentle Kansai elder wisdom. Measured pace, each word carries its own weight. Quiet conviction. Not lecturing—just speaking what he knows to be true after seventy years.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: こうやって、続けていきたい。
lines.en: I want to keep this going—just like this.
lines.style: Soft, tender Kansai sincerity. Slight catch of emotion under the warmth. Not performing his vulnerability, just naming it. Hopeful without being fragile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet, genuine contentment. Slow, careful delivery—not breathless, just present. Tender wife speaking a simple truth. No embellishment needed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered eight-year-old joy. Quick, clear, unashamed. Pure affection—not performed, just said because it's true and she can't hold it back.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Warm, bright Kansai pride. Laugh is quick and genuine, not loud—amused at her niece's openness. Fond teasing in the 'fine girl.' The aunt who raises you up.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Right then—shall we have another round?
lines.style: Warm Kansai ease. Soft invitation, not pressure. Small chuckle under the words. The man who knows how to keep the gathering alive without force.
